2115919005999669736.en_summary: $AMZN CEO Andy Jassy says CapEx will rise “meaningfully more” in 2027 from ~$220B this year with AWS customers consuming capacity almost as fast as it's installed. Pretty telling for $NBIS, $IREN and $CRWV when even $GOOGL is now renting outside compute because hyperscalers simply can't build fast enough.
2115919005999669736.zh_summary: $AMZN CEO Andy Jassy 表示資本支出將在2027年從今年約2200億美元「顯著增加」，AWS客戶幾乎以安裝速度消耗產能。這對 $NBIS、$IREN 和 $CRWV 很有指示意義，因為即使 $GOOGL 現在也在租用外部計算資源，因為超大規模業者無法足夠快地建設。

ticker_notes.IREN: 受益於超大規模業者產能不足
ticker_notes.CRWV: 受益於超大規模業者產能不足

2115918984445120962.en_summary: $AMZN CFO: "Moving to our AWS segment, revenue was $46B, and grew 39.3% YoY, driven by both core and AI services. We added $3.8B in QoQ revenue. AWS now has an annualized revenue run rate of $184B."
2115918984445120962.zh_summary: $AMZN CFO：「轉到我們的AWS分部，收入為460億美元，同比增長39.3%，由核心和AI服務共同推動。我們季環比增加了38億美元收入。AWS現在的年化收入運行率為1840億美元。」

ticker_notes.AMZN: AWS收入460億美元，同比增39.3%，年化運行率1840億美元

2115918171756699824.en_summary: $AMZN CEO: "We still expect 2026 cash capex of ~$220 billion, the majority for AWS, and expect to spend meaningfully more in 2027 with a clear line of sight to attractive financial returns as I laid out on our last call."
2115918171756699824.zh_summary: $AMZN CEO：「我們仍預期2026年現金資本支出約2200億美元，大部分用於AWS，並預期2027年將大幅增加支出，對有吸引力的財務回報有清晰預期，正如我在上次電話會議中所述。」

ticker_notes.AMZN: 2026年現金資本支出約2200億美元，2027年將更多

2115917623313740114.en_summary: $INTC Intel CEO: "...while we did well in Q3, there's clearly more work to do. I'm disappointed that we will not be able to meet strong customer demand in this quarter. We face near-term challenges including manufacturing supply shortage, the unprecedented memory crunch, and the resulting softness in PC demand."
2115917623313740114.zh_summary: $INTC Intel CEO：「……雖然我們第三季度表現良好，但顯然還有更多工作要做。我對本季度無法滿足強勁客戶需求感到失望。我們面臨近期挑戰，包括製造供應短缺、前所未有的記憶體短缺，以及由此導致的PC需求疲軟。」

ticker_notes.INTC: 無法滿足需求，面臨供應短缺和PC需求疲軟

2115917353468776619.en_summary: What an insane month for cyber incidents. $2.5B+ just left Binance hot wallets in a suspected hack, and it's only the latest one in finance this month. Mentions Daiwa Securities breach, Korean financial institutions hit, State Bank of India stolen records. CrowdStrike says the Korean attacker used an AI penetration-testing tool. Guardrails on some models are close to nonexistent.
2115917353468776619.zh_summary: 這個月網絡安全事件瘋狂。超過25億美元剛從幣安熱錢包疑似被駭客轉移，這只是本月金融業的最新一起。提及大和證券承包商洩露、韓國金融機構受擊、印度國家銀行客戶記錄被盜。CrowdStrike表示韓國攻擊者使用了AI滲透測試工具。一些模型的防護措施幾乎不存在。
